It was briefly known as '''Los Angeles Complexity''' in ''[[Counter-Strike: Source]]'' during the [[Championship Gaming Series]]. '''Complexity Gaming''' is one of the oldest esports organizations still active in the Counter-Strike scene, first fielding a ''[[Counter-Strike]]'' team as early as 2004.
